<b>Nima:</b> mijoz kelishilgan pulni to':
What: if the client did not pay the agreed money in full, the system calculates itself. You write nothing.

Formula: Agreed − Received = Debt

Two kinds of debt:
🔴 Red — calculated by the system (no deadline)
🟠 Yellow — deadline debt you wrote (with date)

If you agreed a deadline — write with the "Write deadline debt" button, then the system tracks the deadline.

<b>Nima:</b> bu oy hamyoningizga pul qo':
What: whether money was added to your wallet this month or decreased.
Formula: money in − money out

⚠️ This is NOT PROFIT. That is why the name changed.

Why not profit: a deposit given by the client is unearned money yet, you return it with furniture. And material could have gone to another order.

Real profit: the "Profit from orders" card or the "Contracts" section.
<b>Nima:</b> foydadan ustalarga berganda:
What: the part of profit left for you after paying the masters.

Formula:
Profit from orders − Paid to masters = Left for me

Why two numbers: "Profit from orders" — how much earned. "Left for me" — how much of it is yours. Both are needed.

If negative — means more was withdrawn than profit in this period (difference from previous months). Not a mistake.
Foyda, Menga qoldi, Balans — nega har xi: Profit, Left for me, Balance — why different?
Bu <b>uchta boshqa-boshqa</b> raqam. Har:
These are three different numbers. Being different is normal.

💰 Profit from orders — "how much earned in this period".
Formula: contracts − expenses. Only delivered orders.

🧑‍💼 Left for me — "how much of it is mine".
Formula: Profit from orders − paid to masters.

⚖ Balance — "how much is in the wallet now".
Formula: all income − expenses − withdrawals. Does not depend on month filter.

Example: earned 111 mln, gave masters 99 mln → 12 mln left for you, and 32 mln in wallet (with other movements).

"Profit" on home — since the beginning, only own orders. "All" in Finance also counts shared — that is why bigger.
